bounded_execution.milestone1: Implement one fixed FP8 input executor and its private startup layout. Complete build/resource/bounds admission and directed numerical/Graph checks. Run one same-binary paired real-checkpoint comparison of complete current/new projections, including root stores and final merge. A local pass permits dependency-only retention until milestone2. bounded_execution.milestone1_local_gate: Before timing, freeze four B-C/C-B pairs of the complete144-input-projection corpus, rotating all actual layer weights in natural order. Aggregate candidate elapsed must be at most90% of incumbent (at least10% latency cut), and every pair must favor the candidate, with zero complete-output mismatches. The10% floor is prospective and selects a material prerequisite, not an API gain. If a validated payload-feature-selected FP8 panel is found before execution, root may freeze that panel instead; never choose it after viewing timing. All144 layers avoids a new multiGB host feature scan. Startup packing is excluded from hot projection time only because the composition owns it at startup and reports startup cost.
bounded_execution.milestone2: Compose the same exact NV output-lane executor for all Gate/Up and53 packed Down projections, private owner replacement, and explicit canonical M1 binding. After bounded complete projection/state/transaction/Graph/resource admission, return immediately to P65/O16, P8192/O256 and P40000/O256 for both caps. At most one correctness repair across both milestones; no second ownership/layout variant. A negative complete API composition archives the architecture even if FP8 was locally positive.
